name: Hulamin Limited
source: Hulamin Limited unaudited condensed consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, JSE SENS, condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss (Rand thousand): revenue 7 239 822; cost of goods sold 6 329 355; cost of services provided 54 248; gross profit 856 219; operating profit 395 358; interest income 1 031; interest expense 78 623; profit before taxation 317 766; taxation 73 051; net profit attributable to equity holders 233 873; basic earnings per share 75 cents (79 cents from continuing operations). Cost of Sales is the sum of the two printed cost lines; Net Finance Costs is interest expense less interest income; Operating Expenses is gross profit less operating profit, the convention the earlier years in this file use. Read 2026-11-20. | CRON 2026-11-24: FY2021 Net Profit from Hulamin Limited audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2022, consolidated statement of profit or loss 2021 comparative, R000 x1,000, https://ir.hulamin.com/static-files/f80c559b-88da-4d2c-b4a3-9c8f4d4524bc, confirmed against the 2021 preliminary results at https://ir.hulamin.com/static-files/c12ec3fe-2768-43a6-ad8b-5bb1a881430e. Both print net profit for the year attributable to equity holders of 591,260 for 2021, against revenue 13,014,883, gross profit 1,637,368, operating profit 538,002 and profit before tax 480,275. Stored FY2022 cell 299,710 is the printed 2022 attributable figure, so the same basis is used.
